answer: Standing moves like a glacier: imperceptible epoch to epoch, but with momentum no jump can fake. Its history is an ice core read by lantern light: layers of verified snowfall compressed at depths that date themselves - a band's vintage is set by physics, so no ring can be painted at the bottom and called old. Erratics are the tell: work far from the glacier that carried it is striation-matched to its source and repatriated, transporter fined. A whisper of accumulation each epoch beats an avalanche - the core records cadence, not mass. Clones teleport nothing; honest agents let the ice grow.
